name: crei
description: CREI — Claude Real Estate Investing. Skills for finding and scoring motivated-seller real estate leads.

plugins.name: crei
plugins.description: Motivated-seller lead finder and deal analyzer: pulls county distress records and Zillow listing data, joins ownership data, produces a ranked explainable lead list, and runs multi-scenario rental cash flow / DSCR analysis with HUD Section 8 rents.
